key_insight: This paper provides the first international consensus guidelines for Wolfram syndrome care, covering diagnosis, multidisciplinary management, and key specialty domains.
clinical_relevance: It gives clinicians a standardized, globally developed framework for managing a rare, complex neurodegenerative disorder with no disease-modifying treatment.
method: Modified three-round Delphi process with international specialists across six clinical domains
Input also incorporated from nurses, patient organizations, genetics experts, patients, and families
evidence_signal: All 35 final consensus statements met the predefined threshold of at least 80% agreement across experts.
watch_item: These are consensus-based recommendations rather than outcomes-tested interventions, so implementation should be paired with prospective audit and real-world evaluation.
paper_title: Consensus Recommendations for the Clinical Management of Wolfram syndrome Using a Delphi Method
